content: Duhkhanushayi dveshah. (Aversion is the reactive repulsion toward the memory of past pain).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Duhkhanushayi dveshah. (Aversion is the reactive repulsion t...) focuses directly on duhkhanushayi and dveshah. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on duhkhanushayi today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper duhkhanushayi and dveshah in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
